prompt: A 3x3 sheet of nine icons on a solid flat background #091951 (deep indigo navy), generous even spacing, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos or brand marks (the devices must NOT show any Apple logo). Objects, left to right, top to bottom: 1 lightning bolt, 2 painter's palette, 3 paintbrush, 4 designer's color eyedropper (pipette), 5 light bulb, 6 tablet with stylus, 7 open laptop, 8 all-in-one desktop computer on a stand, 9 smartphone. STRICT THREE-COLOR LOCK for the whole sheet: background #091951, pure white #ffffff, and ONE accent orange #ff6500. No other hues, no tints, no grey, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no texture, no glow. Completely flat vector art with crisp edges. This must NOT look like a stock icon set: no standard pictogram proportions, no stiff symmetry, no generic clip-art. It must feel like a hand-crafted, confident, witty set from a creative agency with a strong point of view, consistent across all nine. CONCEPT 'the trail': every object is caught IN ACTION, slightly tilted and energetic, drawn as bold, very rounded, chunky white shapes. Its motion leaves ONE short curved trail in orange shaped like an arc of a circle (a segment of an orbit), and that arc ends in ONE solid orange dot. The paintbrush's stroke is the arc ending in the dot; the bolt strikes along an arc ending in the dot; the eyedropper's drop falls along an arc and the drop is the dot; the bulb switches on and its light is the dot with a short arc around it; the devices each emit a short arc ending in the dot (like a notification or a thought leaving the screen). Orange appears ONLY in that arc and that dot.
